def fit_ranker(X, y, n_groups, k, lr, random_state, *, sample_weight):
    import lightgbm as lgb
    model = lgb.LGBMRanker(objective='lambdarank', metric='ndcg', lambdarank_truncation_level=k, boosting_type='gbdt', max_depth=3, num_leaves=7, min_child_samples=20, learning_rate=float(lr), n_estimators=200, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0, n_jobs=1, random_state=int(random_state), verbosity=-1, deterministic=True, force_row_wise=True)
    model.fit(X, y, group=np.full(n_groups, k, dtype=np.int32), eval_at=[1, k], sample_weight=_h322_validate(sample_weight, len(X), 'topk.fit_ranker'))
    return model

def fit_ranker_n(X, y, n_groups, k, lr, n_est, random_state, *, sample_weight):
    """Exact topk.fit_ranker configuration stopped at n_estimators = int(n_est) (verified bit-identical to
    fitting 200 trees and predicting with num_iteration = int(n_est))."""
    import lightgbm as lgb
    model = lgb.LGBMRanker(objective='lambdarank', metric='ndcg', lambdarank_truncation_level=k, boosting_type='gbdt', max_depth=3, num_leaves=7, min_child_samples=20, learning_rate=float(lr), n_estimators=int(n_est), subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0, n_jobs=1, random_state=int(random_state), verbosity=-1, deterministic=True, force_row_wise=True)
    model.fit(X, y, group=np.full(n_groups, k, dtype=np.int32), eval_at=[1, k], sample_weight=_h322_validate(sample_weight, len(X), 'bagged.fit_ranker_n'))
    return model

def fit_gate(X, invalid, random_state, *, sample_weight):
    import lightgbm as lgb
    clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(objective='binary', n_estimators=70, learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=15, min_child_samples=25, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_alpha=1.0, reg_lambda=2.0, n_jobs=1, random_state=int(random_state), verbosity=-1, deterministic=True, force_row_wise=True)
    clf.fit(X, invalid.astype(int), sample_weight=_h322_validate(sample_weight, len(X), 'veto.fit_gate'))
    return clf

def run_cell_veto(seed, assess_fold, cids_by_fold, packets, fam_by_cid, k, salt):
    """topk.run_cell with the H273 veto mask applied before every margin selection (selection grid, strict rule and
    random streams identical to RERANK8, so RERANK8 and RERANK8_VETO differ only by the mask)."""

    def ss(*parts):
        return core.stream_seed(*parts, *([salt] if salt else []))
    fit_folds = [f for f in range(5) if f != assess_fold]
    fit_cids = [c for f in fit_folds for c in cids_by_fold[f]]
    fit_fams = sorted({fam_by_cid[c] for c in fit_cids})
    rel_map = {c: packets[c]['rel_k'] for c in fit_cids}
    oof = {(lr, n): {} for lr in core.LR_GRID for n in core.N_EST_GRID}
    oof_p = {}
    for hold in fit_folds:
        core.check_cooperative_pause()
        tr = [c for f in fit_folds if f != hold for c in cids_by_fold[f]]
        va = cids_by_fold[hold]
        X_tr = np.concatenate([packets[c]['X'] for c in tr])
        y_tr = np.concatenate([rel_map[c] for c in tr])
        X_va = np.concatenate([packets[c]['X'] for c in va])
        inv_tr = np.concatenate([~packets[c]['gate_k'] for c in tr])
        gate = fit_gate(X_tr, inv_tr, ss(seed, assess_fold, 'RERANK8_VETO', 'gate', hold), sample_weight=_h322_weights(tr, fam_by_cid, k))
        pv = gate_probs(gate, X_va, len(va), k)
        for i, c in enumerate(va):
            oof_p[c] = pv[i]
        for lr in core.LR_GRID:
            m = topk.fit_ranker(X_tr, y_tr, len(tr), k, lr, ss(seed, assess_fold, 'RERANK8', 'inner', hold, lr), sample_weight=_h322_weights(tr, fam_by_cid, k))
            for n in core.N_EST_GRID:
                p = np.asarray(m.booster_.predict(X_va, num_iteration=int(n)), dtype=np.float64).reshape(len(va), k)
                pm = mask(p, pv)
                for i, c in enumerate(va):
                    oof[lr, n][c] = pm[i]
    r882_u = np.array([packets[c]['r882_u'] for c in fit_cids])
    fams = np.array([fam_by_cid[c] for c in fit_cids])
    masks = [fams == f for f in fit_fams]
    r882_fm = np.array([r882_u[m].mean() for m in masks])
    best_gain, best_cfg, best_d = (-1e+18, (core.LR_GRID[0], core.N_EST_GRID[0], 0.0), np.zeros(len(fit_fams)))
    for lr in core.LR_GRID:
        for n in core.N_EST_GRID:
            for margin in core.MARGIN_GRID:
                if math.isinf(margin):
                    continue
                u = np.array([packets[c]['utility_k'][core.select_from_top4_scores(oof[lr, n][c], margin)] for c in fit_cids])
                d = np.array([u[m].mean() for m in masks]) - r882_fm
                g = float(d.mean())
                if g > best_gain + 1e-12 or (abs(g - best_gain) <= 1e-12 and (margin, -n, -lr) > (best_cfg[2], -best_cfg[1], -best_cfg[0])):
                    best_gain, best_cfg, best_d = (g, (lr, n, margin), d)
    ix = np.random.default_rng(ss(core.BOOT_SEED, 'inner_select', seed, assess_fold, 'RERANK8_VETO')).integers(0, len(fit_fams), (core.INNER_BOOT_DRAWS, len(fit_fams)))
    lcb, ucb = np.quantile(best_d[ix].mean(axis=1), [0.025, 0.975]).tolist()
    admitted = bool(best_gain > core.STRICT_FIT_MIN_GAIN and lcb > 0.0)
    margin = best_cfg[2] if admitted else math.inf
    X_fit = np.concatenate([packets[c]['X'] for c in fit_cids])
    model = topk.fit_ranker(X_fit, np.concatenate([rel_map[c] for c in fit_cids]), len(fit_cids), k, best_cfg[0], ss(seed, assess_fold, 'RERANK8', 'outer', best_cfg[0]), sample_weight=_h322_weights(fit_cids, fam_by_cid, k))
    gate = fit_gate(X_fit, np.concatenate([~packets[c]['gate_k'] for c in fit_cids]), ss(seed, assess_fold, 'RERANK8_VETO', 'gate', 'outer'), sample_weight=_h322_weights(fit_cids, fam_by_cid, k))
    assess = cids_by_fold[assess_fold]
    X_a = np.concatenate([packets[c]['X'] for c in assess])
    sc = mask(np.asarray(model.booster_.predict(X_a, num_iteration=int(best_cfg[1])), dtype=np.float64).reshape(len(assess), k), gate_probs(gate, X_a, len(assess), k))
    picks = [core.select_from_top4_scores(sc[i], margin) for i in range(len(assess))]
    receipt = dict(arm='RERANK8_VETO', k=k, tau=TAU, lr=float(best_cfg[0]), n_estimators=int(best_cfg[1]), margin=float(best_cfg[2]), inner_fit_family_gain=float(best_gain), inner_fit_ci95=[lcb, ucb], strict_admitted=admitted, strict_margin='inf' if math.isinf(margin) else float(margin))
    return dict(receipt=receipt, model=model.booster_.model_to_string(), gate=gate.booster_.model_to_string(), n_estimators=int(best_cfg[1]), margin=margin, assess_picks=picks)

def fit_and_freeze_member(fold_dir: Path, outer_fold: int, root_seed: int, member_idx: int, member_seed: int, outer_train_rows: list[dict[str, Any]], outer_train_packets: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], outer_train_fam_by_cid: dict[str, str], X_check_64: np.ndarray, core: Any, veto: Any, bagged: Any, ens: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Fit one H300/H302 BAG_SWITCH member strictly on outer_train families, serialize its 10 LightGBM models,
    and verify 64-context reload bit-exactness on outer_train before any outer_test read."""
    cids_by_fold = ens.family_folds(outer_train_rows, outer_train_fam_by_cid, member_seed, n=4)
    cids_by_fold[0] = [cids_by_fold[1][0]]
    rv = veto.run_cell_veto(member_seed, 0, cids_by_fold, outer_train_packets, outer_train_fam_by_cid, ens.K, '')
    best_lr = float(rv['receipt']['lr'])
    best_n = int(rv['receipt']['n_estimators'])
    raw_margin = float(rv['receipt']['margin'])
    strict_margin = rv['margin']
    admitted = bool(rv['receipt']['strict_admitted'])
    fit_folds = [1, 2, 3, 4]
    fit_cids = [c for f in fit_folds for c in cids_by_fold[f]]
    fit_fams = sorted({outer_train_fam_by_cid[c] for c in fit_cids})
    f2c: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for c in fit_cids:
        f2c.setdefault(outer_train_fam_by_cid[c], []).append(c)
    prefix = f'f{outer_fold}-r{root_seed}-m{member_idx}-s{member_seed}'
    r_path = fold_dir / f'{prefix}-ranker.txt'
    v_path = fold_dir / f'{prefix}-veto.txt'
    r_path.write_text(rv['model'])
    v_path.write_text(rv['gate'])
    r_info = ens.verify_reload(rv['model'], r_path, X_check_64, num_iteration=best_n)
    v_info = ens.verify_reload(rv['gate'], v_path, X_check_64, num_iteration=None)
    bag_infos = []
    for b in range(bagged.N_BAGS):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(core.stream_seed(member_seed, 0, 'BAG_SWITCH', 'outer_boot', b))
        bfams = rng.choice(fit_fams, size=len(fit_fams), replace=True)
        bcids = [c for f in bfams for c in f2c[f]]
        Xb = np.concatenate([outer_train_packets[c]['X'] for c in bcids])
        yb = np.concatenate([outer_train_packets[c]['rel_k'] for c in bcids])
        mb = bagged.fit_ranker_n(Xb, yb, len(bcids), ens.K, best_lr, best_n, core.stream_seed(member_seed, 0, 'BAG_SWITCH', 'outer_bag', b), sample_weight=_h322_weights(bcids, outer_train_fam_by_cid, ens.K))
        m_str = mb.booster_.model_to_string()
        b_path = fold_dir / f'{prefix}-bag{b}.txt'
        b_path.write_text(m_str)
        b_info = ens.verify_reload(m_str, b_path, X_check_64, num_iteration=best_n)
        b_info['bag_index'] = int(b)
        bag_infos.append(b_info)
    return {'outer_fold': int(outer_fold), 'root_seed': int(root_seed), 'member_index': int(member_idx), 'seed': int(member_seed), 'selected_lr': best_lr, 'selected_n_estimators': best_n, 'raw_margin': raw_margin, 'strict_margin': 'inf' if math.isinf(strict_margin) else float(strict_margin), 'strict_admitted': admitted, 'inner_fit_family_gain': float(rv['receipt']['inner_fit_family_gain']), 'inner_fit_ci95': rv['receipt']['inner_fit_ci95'], 'selected_tau': float(veto.TAU), 'n_bags': int(bagged.N_BAGS), 'q_fixed': int(bagged.Q_FIXED), 'ranker': r_info, 'veto': v_info, 'bags': bag_infos}
